hero.text: Meet the person. Every system starts with a person. This one starts with Yuqi. I'll show you the work, the thinking, and the life around it.

about.text: Beyond the headline. A title is a starting point, not the whole story. Here is the person behind the projects.

background.text: The path here. Experience gives the work its context. Follow the roles and education, then open the CV for the full picture.

projects.text: Don't take my word for it. The work is right here. Pick something that catches your eye; let's get closer to what it actually does.

techblogs.text: Inside the thinking. Code shows the result. Writing opens up the reasoning. Follow a question into the article behind it.

life.text: A life outside the editor. A different side of the same person. These are the stories beyond systems and software.

realtime.text: A site that stays awake. This isn't just a collection of screenshots. Here, the page connects to live services. Look at the data, then follow it to the dashboard.

contact.text: The next part is a conversation. You've seen the work and met the person. A collaboration, a question, or simply hello: this is where the next chapter starts.

hero.text: 认识一个人。每个系统背后都有一个人。这里是育奇的世界：作品、思考，以及代码以外的生活。

about.text: 不止一个头衔。头衔只是起点。看看这些项目背后的人，以及他关注什么。

background.text: 走到这里的路。经历让作品有了上下文。从工作与教育背景出发，再到简历里看完整的脉络。

projects.text: 让作品自己说话。作品就在这里。选一个让你好奇的，我们一起看看它真正解决了什么问题。

techblogs.text: 走进思考过程。代码呈现结果，文字展开推理。带着一个问题，走进文章里的设计取舍。

life.text: 编辑器之外。同一个人的另一面。这些故事发生在系统与软件之外。

realtime.text: 一个仍在运行的网站。这里不只是截图。页面连接着实时服务，从眼前的数据继续走进仪表盘。

contact.text: 下一章，从对话开始。看过作品，也认识了这个人。合作、问题，或者简单的一声你好，下一章从这里开始。
